issues.title: [Debug] chat · COMBINED_REQUIREMENTS_UNMET · final_synthesis
confirmed_facts: CHAT_FAILURE at final_synthesis, provider OPENROUTER, public code COMBINED_REQUIREMENTS_UNMET.
Provider text was seen and an answer event was emitted; the report does not establish a checked final answer or successful fulfillment.
Local diagnostic counters: TOPIC gap, 113 issues, 105 FAIL checks, 5 NEEDS_VERIFICATION checks, zero repair rounds, SINGLE_PASS_LOCAL_CHECKS_ONLY.
Origin is LOCAL_RECOVERY; phase provenance is CAPTURE_BOUNDARY_ONLY, causal provenance is UNAVAILABLE, and recovery observation is UNOBSERVED.
issues.source_interpretation: The source producer emits this exact final diagnostic tuple for protocol-complete output that fails local completion requirements. Single-pass policy leaves repairRounds=0 and forbids an automatic verifier/replacement repair. Checked-final publication remains gated; a retained answer event can be a visibly unfinished draft. Existing recovery classifies this as COMPLETE_NEEDS_CORRECTION and REVIEW_COMPLETED_ANSWER, and rejects ordinary unfinished-record resume.
actions_completed: Read the complete approved body; verified its approved-payload SHA256 and preserved the difference from #2826 unknown remote completion.
Matched all six exported requirement fields to combinedRequirementEvidence and traced checked-final publication and new-revision recovery.
Confirmed CombinedDeliverySession, CombinedRecoveryFailure and CombinedRecoverySnapshot are byte-identical to the captured app commit.
Executed the existing consumed-single-pass/new-revision and known-not-dispatched-retry cases as part of the six-case current-source host qualification; both passed.
recommended_recovery: Review the retained completed draft and its unmet topic/verification checks.
Accept a new answer revision to correct the missing requirements, preserving the original contributions and revision ownership.
Do not resume this as an unfinished delivery, silently repeat the consumed writer request, or override the accepted single-pass constraint.
limits: The original request, answer body, individual failed-check IDs, quality report, source claims, and accepted policy snapshot are absent, so semantic failure or a false-positive topic check cannot be reproduced from this capsule.
113 issues, 105 failed checks and 5 unverified checks are different aggregates; they are not a completion denominator and do not imply that exactly three checks passed.
provider OPENROUTER identifies the capture context, not an HTTP/provider outage; no HTTP code or provider failure is supplied.
The six host cases qualify ledger/recovery policy, not CombinedDeliverySession rendering or the 105 individual topic failures.
The app-wide earlier CHAT_FAILED event and #2826 are separate evidence; there is no supplied causal link.
